from-coping-to-cure.p043-0: Table 3, Spirit-Controlled Living vs. Sin-Controlled Living. Spirit-Filled Mind: forgiveness, hope, appreciation, willingness, impartiality, self-control, mercy, humility, thankfulness, confidence, wisdom, faithfulness, gratitude. Sins of the Mind: evil thoughts, unforgiveness, covetousness, greed, lust, arrogance, despiteful, pride, ingratitude, selfish ambition, deceitfulness, heartless, faithless, haughty. Spirit-Filled Emotions: love, peace, gentle spirit, gladness, joy, long-suffering, kindly spirit, patient, compassionate. Sinful Emotions: hatred, rebellion, bitterness, envy, bad temper, anger, unloving attitude, jealousy, malice, rage. Spirit-Filled Mouth: truthfulness, thankfulness, gentle answer, encouraging, tact, praise, timeliness, soothing tongue, pleasant words. Sins of the Mouth: lying, complaining, yelling, contentiousness, boasting, gossip, slandering, disputing, backbiting, quarrelsomeness, blasphemy. Spirit-Filled Behavior: kindness, righteousness, obedience, goodness, courage, endurance, considerate, gentleness, self-control, cooperation, sincerity, servant, submissive, impartial. Sins of Behavior: fornication, adultery, drunkenness, murder, revelry, insolent, ruthless, factions, brutality, without self-control, stealing, violence, disobedience to parents, brawling, favoritism.

timeless-love-transforming-love.p023-0: Table comparing Faith Promises and Love Promises. Faith promises come by faith in Jesus as the Son of God; love promises come by knowing and experiencing Jesus' love. Faith: defined by a one-time decision; Love: defined by a continual abiding. Faith: Spirit is born again; Love: Soul is renewed. Faith: mark the beginning of the Christian life; Love: mark the fulfillment of the Christian life. Faith: work backward in time to cover past sins; Love: work forward in time by changing the sin nature. Faith: result in justified; Love: result in glorified. Faith: make us children of God; Love: make us sons of God. Faith: grant eternal life in heaven; Love: grant Christlikeness in this life.
